description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractExpression' within the Twig templating engine, representing a general expression node in the abstract syntax tree. It provides methods for handling generator attribute and explicit parentheses in expressions.

classes.name: AbstractExpression
classes.description: An abstract class for all expression nodes in the Twig syntax tree, extending Node, providing utility methods related to expression attributes.

methods.name: isGenerator
methods.description: Checks if the expression node has the 'is_generator' attribute set to true.

methods.name: setExplicitParentheses
methods.description: Sets the 'with_parentheses' attribute to true, indicating the expression should be wrapped in parentheses.

methods.name: hasExplicitParentheses
methods.description: Determines if the expression node has explicitly been marked to include parentheses.
